verdict.rationale: An API platform like DeepSeek could plausibly publish an llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions llms.txt, markdown docs for LLMs, or docs built for agent consumption. The related items, such as OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility, using DeepSeek as a backend for Claude Code, and the DeepSeek Harness preview, are different capabilities and do not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
